_note: K2: the framework's tunables (src/coach/analyze, src/coach/report/format.ts, src/coach/detect/common.ts). docs/coach/mechanics.md, 'Framework'.

prioritizer._: First prioritizer (K5 replaces it): priority = impact × confidence. At most maxFixes fixes, never two of one detector family (the id up to the second dot); up to maxStrengths strengths. A finding below minConfidence is not chosen.

confidence._: Sample-size factor: 1 − exp(−n / nScale), where each detector gives its own nScale in its area file; strengths also need rank ≤ strengthMaxRank among at least strengthMinLobby players with a value.

clock._: Round clock for finding texts: roundSec from the freeze end; after the plant the bomb timer (bombSec).
